entries.name: Catala programming language for law

licence.basis: GitHub licence metadata for CatalaLang/catala reports Apache-2.0 (read 2026-11-11).

norn.overlap: statutes as code with prioritized default logic (exceptions over base rules), scope inputs and outputs, legal-article citations

priority.reason: Prioritized default logic matches Norn's exception trees (#1207); tax and labour rules as code.

entries.notes: Default-logic exceptions map to LawIR exception trees and norm precedence; each Catala scope cites its article, which maps to a LegalSource link. A real tax rule set translated and was proven in prior research (#1128).

entries.name: European Legislation Identifier (ELI) ontology
entries.publisher: Publications Office of the European Union
entries.versionBasis: The EU Vocabularies ELI page links a release note and version history but states no version on the page itself.

licence.text: EU Publications Office legal notice (reuse policy not read)
licence.basis: The ELI page has no licence statement; its legal notice page was not read, so the Commission reuse policy is not confirmed for this artifact.

norn.overlap: identifiers and FRBR-style metadata for legislation, versions and consolidations

priority.reason: Stable identifiers for legal-source provenance links.

entries.notes: Ships eli.owl and a schema.org legal alignment (eli-sdo.ttl). Used for stable legal-source identifiers in law provenance links.

entries.name: LegalDocML / Akoma Ntoso 1.0 XML schema
entries.versionBasis: OASIS Standard heading/header dated 29 August 2018; embedded schema history says release 30/03/2017. These are different release identities, preserved rather than conflated.

licence.basis: XSD expressly grants CC BY 4.0; attribution and modification notices required. Grant does not cover legislation or judgments supplied by another publisher.

norn.overlap: Document, version, citation and provenance; legislative XML is not a general contract ontology.

priority.reason: Legislation text as the source each law links to.

entries.notes: Akoma Ntoso is the LegalDocML standard, not two independent schemas to count twice. Redistribution: license-conditions.

entries.name: LegalRuleML 1.0 compact XML schema
entries.versionBasis: OASIS Standard and XSD header date.

licence.basis: XSD says OASIS copyright/all rights reserved. No artifact-specific redistribution/derivative grant established by this review; do not infer from public download.

norn.overlap: Rules, temporal validity, obligations and defeasibility; no automatic lowering to executable decision rules.

priority.reason: Interchange for defeasible norms; ~9% coverage in research (#1128).

entries.name: LKIF Core legal ontology
entries.publisher: ESTRELLA project (Leibniz Center for Law); maintained by R. Hoekstra
entries.versionBasis: No release tags; the date is the last push to RinkeHoekstra/lkif-core on GitHub.

licence.basis: LICENSE file in RinkeHoekstra/lkif-core is CC BY 4.0 (read 2026-11-11).

norn.overlap: norms, legal roles, legal actions and qualifications as OWL modules

priority.reason: Law-as-code feeds country packs and defeasible laws.

entries.notes: 15 OWL modules (norm, legal-role, legal-action, time, mereology). Alignment vocabulary for LawIR norm kinds; not an executable rule language.
